description: Turns the entity into a projectile: a thrown or shot entity that flies along a ballistic arc and reacts when it impacts a block, a fluid, or another entity.

anchor.description: Reference point on the shooter used to position the projectile at spawn: `0` = origin (feet), `1` = eye height, `2` = middle of the bounding box.

angle_offset.description: Additional upwards pitch (in degrees) applied to the shooter's aim direction at launch. Negative values aim downward.

catch_fire.description: Legacy default for whether the projectile sets the entity hit on fire. Prefer the `catch_fire` on-hit subcomponent.

crit_particle_on_hurt.description: If `true`, critical-hit particles are spawned on the projectile when it is struck.

destroy_on_hurt.description: If `true`, the projectile is removed from the world when struck.

gravity.description: Downward acceleration (blocks per tick squared) applied each tick while in flight. Higher values make the projectile fall faster.

hit_ground_sound.description: Identifier of the sound to play when the projectile hits a block. Defaults to `hit_sound` when empty.

hit_nearest_passenger.description: If `true`, when the projectile hits a vehicle with at least one passenger, the on-hit behavior is applied to the passenger closest to the impact point instead of the vehicle itself.

hit_sound.description: Identifier of the sound to play when the projectile hits an entity. Also used for block hits when `hit_ground_sound` is not specified.

hit_water.description: If `true`, the projectile treats water as a hit surface and stops on contact.

homing.description: If `true`, the projectile steers towards an active target while in flight.

ignored_entities.description: Array of entity identifiers that the projectile will pass through without registering a hit.

inertia.description: Fraction of the projectile's velocity preserved each tick while traveling through air. Values below `1.0` cause it to slow down over time.

is_dangerous.description: If `true`, the projectile is flagged as dangerous, affecting AI reactions and certain client-side behaviors.

isolated_physics.description: If `true`, the projectile uses a dedicated ballistic physics path and ignores generic actor movement systems (friction, drag, etc.). Recommended for custom projectiles.

lightning.description: If `true`, the projectile can channel a lightning bolt when it hits an entity during a thunderstorm.

liquid_inertia.description: Fraction of the projectile's velocity preserved each tick while traveling through a fluid.

multiple_targets.description: If `true`, the projectile can hit more than one entity over the course of its flight; if `false`, it stops at the first entity it hits. Projectiles launched with the Piercing enchantment have this value set to `true`.

offset.description: Offset, relative to the `anchor`, at which the projectile is spawned when fired by the shooter.

on_fire_time.description: Duration in seconds for which an entity set on fire by this projectile remains burning. Applied both by the legacy top-level `catch_fire` flag and by the `catch_fire` on-hit subcomponent.

on_hit.description: Map of on-hit subcomponents that drive what happens when the projectile impacts a block, fluid, or entity. Each key is a subcomponent name and its value is that subcomponent's configuration.

particle.description: Particle effect emitted at the impact location when the projectile hits something.

potion_effect.description: Default potion aux value associated with the projectile. Normally set programmatically by potion items; rarely useful at authoring time. A value matching the water potion is required for the `douse_fire` on-hit subcomponent to extinguish fires.

power.description: Initial speed (in blocks per tick) at which the projectile is launched.

reflect_immunity.description: Duration in seconds after launch during which the projectile cannot be reflected by being struck.

reflect_on_hurt.description: If `true`, the projectile reverses direction when struck, reflecting back towards the attacker.

shoot_sound.description: Identifier of the sound to play when the projectile is fired.

shoot_target.description: If `true`, the projectile is aimed at the shooter's current target (when one exists) rather than straight ahead.

should_bounce.description: Controls whether the projectile bounces off entities on impact. `no` disables bouncing, `if_invulnerable` bounces only off invulnerable entities, and `if_no_damage_dealt` bounces whenever no damage is dealt to the target.

splash_range.description: Splash radius (in blocks) used when applying potion effects via the splash/lingering potion code path.

stop_on_hurt.description: If `true`, the projectile has its velocity zeroed out when struck.

uncertainty_base.description: Base inaccuracy added to the launch direction. The total inaccuracy is `uncertainty_base - difficultyLevel * uncertainty_multiplier`.

uncertainty_multiplier.description: Per-difficulty-level reduction in inaccuracy. See `uncertainty_base` for the full formula.

title: minecraft:projectile
